messages:
maya: quick note from pairing: autoscaler keeps picking static MIG profiles and we pay fragmentation tax. idea: runtime offers a compact "frag-aware node selection" response — a few concrete node templates plus a tiny intent signature and stability score so operator can pick with low coupling.

thomas: concrete fields? keep minimal. template_id, split_desc, util_range, frag_delta_est, warmup_s, preempt_risk (low/med/high), stability_hint (minutes). also include coalesce_hints mapping indexes of pending slices.

eli: operator needs hard constraints: e.g., must_support_full_gpu=true. runtime should filter templates incompatible with pool constraints. that avoids accidental blocking of pinned jobs.

zoe: good call. also add an ordinal "rollback_risk" flag: how risky switching templates is for short-lived windows (helps hysteresis). runtime can compute from recent flip rate + admission variance.

ran: implement note: do not load models. use cached perf profiles and the seq-length histogram. coalesce hints can be cheap knapsack approximations. responses must be tiny — autoscaler will call this in the hot path.

maya: telemetry: node_selection_requests, template_chosen, frag_delta_post_launch (operator reports back), stability_score_trend, contract_mismatch_count (when operator rejects for constraints). add watchdog to auto-disable per-pool if pinned-job p99 latency regresses >5% over 10m.

thomas: rollout: per-pool opt-in flag, default off. TTL on recs (suggest 15m) and a confidence threshold to avoid chop-chop. operator should only switch when stability_hint expired and confidence is med|high.

eli: eviction ledger integration: runtime returns preempt_risk + est_evictions_per_hour; operator maps to cost, factoring preemptibility of the pool. this keeps operators in control of economics.

zoe: testing plan: 1) offline sim with historical admission traces to measure frag_delta and eviction impact; 2) small canary pool honors recs only when pack_opt_in=true; 3) synthetic pinned-job spikes to validate watchdog.

ran: actionable items: maya will draft RFC + example JSON responses; thomas add sim job with mixed traces; eli implement cheap coalesce knapsack in runtime shim; zoe define telemetry & dashboards and add rollback guard; infra-bot create tracking issue.

infra-bot: ticket INF-7001 created: "frag-aware node selection API + operator integration"

maya: timeline suggestion: RFC today, prototype next week, canary in two weeks. will post RFC draft in channel in ~1h :rocket:
